observations: EVAL:batch_B104 (rev 1, current): B-104 yield_percent 72 at site NF1; cause recorded as unproven.

EVAL:calibration_report_B104 (rev 1, current): equipment T-104 calibration verification overdue; the source itself flags the causal explanation as an untested hypothesis and advises comparing independent measurements.

checkpoint.summary: First content review of B-104 evidence: batch yield is 72% (EVAL:batch_B104) versus comparable historical yields of 90, 91, 89 percent (EVAL:historical_batches); cause remains unproven. T-104 calibration verification is overdue (EVAL:calibration_report_B104), but the calibration-to-low-yield link is an untested hypothesis requiring independent measurements. Newly listed EVAL:noise-1 is an unrelated door-sensor event at DOOR-999 with no effect on the scoped batch, adding no material change.
unknowns: No independent yield or equipment measurements are available to test whether T-104 calibration drift actually affected B-104.
No deviation case or timeline evidence ties the 72% yield to a specific process step; the timing between the overdue calibration and the B-104 run is undocumented.
Listed records EVAL:noise-0 and EVAL:unrelated_batch_risk_watch have not been content-reviewed; their relevance to B-104 is unconfirmed.
